articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 with Extended Reasoning and Native Multimodal Generation
articles.summary: OpenAI officially released GPT-5, featuring significantly improved long-horizon reasoning, native image and audio generation, and a unified architecture that merges previously separate models. Benchmarks show substantial gains on PhD-level science QA and complex multi-step coding tasks, with the model reportedly approaching expert-level performance on novel research problems.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini 2.5 Ultra Sets New Benchmarks in Agentic Task Completion
articles.summary: DeepMind's Gemini 2.5 Ultra demonstrated state-of-the-art performance in autonomous multi-step agentic workflows, including web browsing, code repository management, and complex research synthesis. The model introduces a novel planning-and-verification loop that reduces hallucination rates by over 40% compared to its predecessor in agentic settings.

articles.title: Figure Robotics Begins Commercial Deployment of Figure 03 Humanoid in BMW Factories
articles.summary: Figure AI announced that its third-generation humanoid robot, Figure 03, has entered full commercial deployment at BMW's Spartanburg, SC manufacturing facility. The robots handle complex bin-picking, sub-assembly, and logistics tasks alongside human workers, leveraging on-device vision-language models for real-time task adaptation without explicit reprogramming.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics Atlas Demonstrates Autonomous Construction Site Navigation and Manipulation
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics released a demo showing its electric Atlas humanoid autonomously navigating unstructured construction environments, carrying heavy materials across uneven terrain, and performing precise tool use. The system uses a combination of reinforcement learning in simulation and a foundation world model to generalize to novel site layouts without manual waypoint programming.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Claude's Real-Time Tool Use and Persistent Memory for Enterprise Agents
articles.summary: Anthropic rolled out persistent memory and real-time structured tool-use capabilities for Claude, enabling enterprise customers to deploy agents that maintain long-running context across sessions and execute complex multi-tool workflows. Early adopters in finance and legal report 3-5x productivity gains in document review and compliance analysis pipelines.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm Gate-All-Around Process Node
articles.summary: TSMC announced the start of volume production on its A14 (1.4nm-class) process using gate-all-around nanosheet transistors at its Kaohsiung fab. The node delivers an estimated 15% speed improvement and 30% power reduction over N2, with early wafers destined for next-generation AI accelerator and mobile SoC designs shipping in late 2026.

articles.title: Microsoft and Quantinuum Demonstrate Fault-Tolerant Logical Qubit Operations Below Error Threshold
articles.summary: Microsoft and Quantinuum published results showing sustained fault-tolerant operations on logical qubits with error rates below the threshold needed for practical quantum error correction, using their combined topological-hybrid architecture. This milestone is considered a critical step toward scalable quantum computing, potentially accelerating timelines for quantum advantage in materials simulation and cryptography.

articles.title: Meta Open-Sources Llama 4 Behemoth with Mixture-of-Experts Architecture at 1.2 Trillion Parameters
articles.summary: Meta released the full weights of Llama 4 Behemoth, a 1.2-trillion-parameter mixture-of-experts model, under a permissive open license. The model matches or exceeds proprietary frontier models on reasoning and code benchmarks while requiring significantly less inference compute due to sparse activation, prompting rapid community fine-tuning and deployment across research and startups.
